QUOTE: Each handler is a mixin function of the form `const XHandler = <TBase extends Constructor<ServerDataOperatorBase>>(superclass) => class extends superclass {...}`.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states that each mixin is constrained to extend ServerDataOperatorBase (which extends BaseDataOperator) and that every handler write funnels through `BaseDataOperator.batchRecords`. It does not tie the two together as cause and effect, but both halves are stated.
